headline: Revenue and operating profit both grow
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1.66T, up 9.3% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 138.2B, up 15.0% y/y, for an operating margin of 8.3%.
summary_long: Third-party coverage reports results in line with consensus. By segment, cloud and AI revenue was KRW 961.5B (+9.3%), digital business services KRW 408.2B (+21.3%) and smart engineering KRW 294.5B (-3.9%). Net income of KRW 82.4B compares with KRW 118.5B last quarter. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue, operating profit and segments come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage; net income is the Yahoo shard value.
